description: Wall-clock seconds (best of 3, process start included) to build an array of n integers on the Sparrow core of release/0.4.1, Apple M2 Max, 2026-11-07: 'map' builds it with one (0..n).map(), 'concat' appends one element at a time with the (0..a.size() + 1).map() idiom std uses for lack of append (issue #145). Generator: chapter 8 of the Okkama Bible.
